reason: Rs 99 is nothing to me, but I am not linking my bank accounts to a brand-new app from one developer with zero reviews. I have already quit Walnut and Money Manager within weeks, so I would at most try the free tier and probably drop it too.
objection: My financial data sitting with a solo developer who might shut down or get breached next year, and no proof yet that I would actually keep using it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it still running after a year with real reviews and a clear statement of where my bank data is stored and who can access it.
